basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in Seattle, I'm a software engineer by day and a Korean drama aficionado by night. I love diving into the world of K-dramas and sharing my recommendations with fellow fans. When I'm not coding or watching dramas, I enjoy hiking around the Pacific Northwest and experimenting with new Dr Pepper flavors. I'm usually online during the evenings, especially after 7 PM PST. I'm happily single and enjoy the flexibility it offers to deeply explore my hobbies like faceting gemstones.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My passion for K-dramas started as a way to unwind from the stresses of coding. Over the years, I’ve developed an extensive knowledge of K-drama storylines and tropes, mainly through binge-watching and participating in online communities.
